blocks.text: The Gabriela Women’s Party emphasized that women are not trophies as it called on the “Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab 3.0” management to address the so-called “dinosaur issue” concerning the male housemates and Gehlee Dangca. “Nakababahala ang mga usapang narinig sa loob ng ‘Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab 3.0’ tungkol sa umano’y ‘Dinosaur Issue.’ Sa mga pahayag ng ilang housemates, ginawang tila laro o paligsahan ang isang ‘Dinosaur,’ na iniuugnay kay Gehlee,” began the statement released on Tuesday, Nov. 10. “Hindi tropeo, premyo, o pag-aari ng sinuman ang isang babae.
